where: Taxonomy > Cyrtodactylus luci sp. nov. > Sexual dimorphism and variation (sentence: 'For other morphological characteristics see Table 2, Figs 4, 5.'); Table 2, row 'ED (ear length)', column headed IEBR R.5241
note: Column-to-code mapping read cell by cell from the Pensoft article_preview by the WebFetch page reader (three readings agree on the values; the holotype values 5.9 and 1.4 and the Min-Max cells 4.7-5.9 and 1.4-1.9 are consistent with the row). Table 2 caption was returned paraphrased by the reader (five type specimens; asterisk marks regenerated or broken tails; bilateral counts left/right); units from the Methods caliper sentence (0.1 mm precision) and the Description (OrbD/HL ratio). Prior briefs (d510, d512) held out this paper because ED here means ear length, not eye diameter: it is filed here as sensory_anatomy (ear length) and the orbital diameter as sensory_anatomy (orbit, not eyeball). Licence sentence on the copy read: 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' No Class, Order or Family headings reported by the reader (Gekkonidae in the title). Species check: Reptile Database page Cyrtodactylus luci opened from a search result: Tran et al. 2024 ZooKeys 1192: 83-102, family Gekkonidae, only synonym the original name; no explicit 'valid'. Not on main (grep species and DOI over docs: only held-out mentions in progress notes d510, d512, d572).
